QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] Ghosts of the Refugee Zone
QuestInfo.0: You enter Azwan through the Grave Robber's Tunnel and found the #bRefugee Zone#k filled with ghosts. Talk to #bMedina#k the ghost.
QuestInfo.1: According to Azwan's shamaness Medina, the ghosts of the Refugee Zone are the #bAzwan residents from hundreds of years ago#k. They set up a barrier to prevent Hilla from stealing their souls and weren't aware time had passed.
QuestInfo.2: Medina said she will help if you're collecting information on Hilla.

0.0: Sorry, we'd never considered that anyone than Hilla's subordinates would try to enter the Refugee Zone. What brings a strong warrior like yourself to Azwan? As you can see, there isn't much here but restless souls...
0.1: Oh, where are my manners? I am Medina, a shamaness of Azwan. I was tasked with keeping an eye on the barrier here, lest the Black Mage come and whisk all our souls away.
0.2: You see, when Hilla the head shamaness presented Azwan to the Black Mage most of our people had their soul stolen, and they subsequently turned into monsters. #bOnly the souls here in the Refugee Zone survived#k. If we leave, the same fate is bound to befall us.
0.3: So I must ask, how DID you get in here? You went under the barrier? Hmm. I'd never considered that. But, isn't it dangerous outside the barrier? What of Hilla's subordinates?
0.4: ...The Black Mage was sealed? And that was hundreds of years ago, you say? And only now has he returned?

yes.0: I-If you don't mind, could I have a moment to sort through all this?

no.0: Oh, this is all so sudden and difficult to process...

1.0: Thank you. To think so much has happened while we were totally unaware.

yes.0: We knew it had been some time, but not hundreds of years. I suppose time is just of little concern to the undead...
yes.1: Regardless, it may be fate that we've been living as ghosts until this very moment. You said that you're to collect information on Hilla and rid the world of the Black Mage, correct?
yes.2: If so, you can count on all of here to help, limited as we are as ghosts. We can finally atone for hiding here when others fell victim to Hilla...
